question: Would it be correct to say “Eight Arms” Kurgan is a spider-type demihuman? Or did Vollachia’s technology or magic give him eight arms?
answer: He was born in a rare tribe of multi-armed people. Their characteristic is having more arms than normal, but even in their tribe, eight arms is top-level. Learning to use all of them well takes about twice as much effort as Tenshinhan’s arm-increasing technique. (Note: That’s another Dragonball reference.)
